gloss: to recognize; to perceive; to be aware of

definitions.explanation: To identify or distinguish something, especially through sensory or technological means.

definitions.gloss: to perceive; to be aware of; to understand
definitions.explanation: To grasp or become conscious of a fact, situation, or problem.

examples.japanese: {顔|かお}{認識|にんしき}でロックを{解除|かいじょ}する。
パソコンが{新|あたら}しいデバイスを{認識|にんしき}しない。
examples.english: The computer doesn't recognize the new device.

examples.japanese: {音声|おんせい}{認識|にんしき}の{精度|せいど}が{年々|ねんねん}{向上|こうじょう}している。
examples.english: The accuracy of voice recognition improves year by year.

examples.japanese: {問題|もんだい}の{深刻|しんこく}さを{認識|にんしき}する。
examples.english: To recognize the seriousness of the problem.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{自分|じぶん}の{立場|たちば}を{正|ただ}しく{認識|にんしき}していない。
examples.english: He doesn't properly understand his own position.

examples.japanese: {国民|こくみん}が{環境|かんきょう}{問題|もんだい}の{重要性|じゅうようせい}を{認識|にんしき}することが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It is important for citizens to be aware of the importance of environmental issues.

notes:
A versatile word used in both technical and abstract contexts. In computing and technology, it refers to identification and detection. In everyday and formal speech, it describes awareness and understanding of situations or facts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {顔|かお}{認識|にんしき}: facial recognition
- {音声|おんせい}{認識|にんしき}: voice recognition
- {現状|げんじょう}{認識|にんしき}: understanding of the current situation
- {認識|にんしき}が{甘|あま}い: to underestimate; to have insufficient awareness
- {認識|にんしき}を{改|あらた}める: to revise one's understanding

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {理解|りかい}する: to understand — focuses on comprehension of meaning or content
- {把握|はあく}する: to grasp — implies firm understanding of details and scope
- {意識|いしき}する: to be conscious of — implies deliberate attention to something
